profile.summary: A California nonprofit, affiliated with the Associated General Contractors (AGC) of California, that works to attract, develop and keep a skilled construction workforce. It runs programs such as Build California, a campaign that promotes construction careers to young people, along with student chapters, scholarships, and training and education.
